snippet.title: Birdteeth - Prerelease Trailer
snippet.description:
Birdteeth is a casual, single-player creature collector where you get to observe, feed, and befriend birds. Train your feathered companions, reshape the world around you, and interact with hidden secrets and puzzles left over from ancient times.  

Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938080/Birdteeth/
